This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Complaint Case No. 578 of 2025 (Old No.944 of 2022), "Smt. Jahira Qureshi Vs. Bilal Qureshi and Others", pending before the Court of learned Ist Additional Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee, District Haridwar under Sections 323,
498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 3 and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2.

entities.text: Smt. Jahira Qureshi Vs. Bilal Qureshi and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Ist Additional Judicial Magistrate, Roorkee, District Haridwar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Mohd. Safdar, learned counsel for the applicants.
Safdar, Advocate, contended that the applicant no.1 is the husband of the respondent-complainant and the respondent no.2 to 9 are the family members of the applicant no.1.
Applicant no.1 had filed a Petition (Case No. 1595 of 2022) against the respondent for restitution of conjugal rights.
The said case has been decreed ex parte on 07.05.2024 (annexure no.3).
4. Notice is being issued to the respondent.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Till then, the further proceedings of the said Complaint Case No.578 of 2025 are stayed.
6. The applicant no.1 and the respondent are directed to appear in- person before this Court on 25.02.2026.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 18.12.2025 Shiv/
